content: The R. Shaqq-i Qamar opens with the author saying he journeyed through the engendered realm and passed the colleges of the formal sciences, where he observed that the discussion among traditionists and theologians about the splitting of the moon (Q 54:1) was especially popular and intense, each scholar trying to establish its meaning. (A literary frame, not necessarily a report of an event.)
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
